'''Luca Schuler''' (born 17 January 1998) is a Swiss [[freestyle skiing|freestyle skier]]. He was born in [[Schwyz]]. 
He competed at the [[2014 Winter Olympics]] in [[Sochi]], in [[Freestyle skiing at the 2014 Winter Olympics – Men's slopestyle|slopestyle]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.olympic.org/luca-schuler |title=Luca Schuler |website=Olympic.org |accessdate=29 January 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.olympic.org/sochi-2014/freestyle-skiing/ski-slopestyle-men |title=Ski slopestyle men |website=Olympic.org |accessdate=29 January 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite Sports-Reference |title=Luca Schuler |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/sc/luca-schuler-1.html |access-date=29 January 2017 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161011095322/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/sc/luca-schuler-1.html |archive-date=11 October 2016 |df=dmy}}</ref>
